title: Nicaragua Decree Drops Cuba and Venezuela From Authorized Foreign Forces; US Limited to Humanitarian Role
detail: Decree 13-2026, published in La Gaceta on October 29, 2026 and signed by Ortega and Murillo, authorizes foreign forces in Nicaragua for Jan 1–Jun 30, 2027. Unlike the two previous decrees it omits Cuba and Venezuela, with no reason given. US forces may enter only for humanitarian aid and search and rescue, coordinated in advance with Nicaragua's army; Russia, China, Mexico and CENTCAM armies are also listed. Reported by a single outlet (The Rio Times, Nov 6); not yet corroborated.

sources.name: The Rio Times: Nicaragua omits Cuban, Venezuelan troops from 2027 decree

confidenceReason: Single Tier-3 report; decree text not independently reviewed.
